name: superdurable-dex
description: Build with Dex SDK, create process products, and contribute official connectors.

interface.shortDescription: Build Dex apps and contribute connectors
interface.longDescription: Use Dex SDK for implementation, Dex App Builder for end-to-end process products, or Dex Connector Contributor to build, verify, and upstream official connector operations, Triggers, and configuration UI units.
defaultPrompt: Use $dex-sdk to design a reliable Dex Flow.
Use $dex-app-builder to design a process application.
Use $dex-app-builder to prototype and build this workflow.
Use $dex-connector-contributor to build and upstream this connector capability.
